The collection

Shop by category

Every piece is chosen for how it photographs, how it feels to sit with, and how well it plays with others.

Chairs

Bentwood, cane, rattan, velvet and iron. Seating that sets the tone before anyone sits down.

Tables

Statement dining tables in burl, travertine, fluted oak and cane, for tablescapes worth photographing.

Lighting & Chandeliers

Softly draped fabric chandeliers that turn any ceiling, tent or tree canopy into the focal point.

Facades & Bars

Bar and stage facades in eight signature styles. Every one can be rebuilt in your colors and fabrics.

Staging & Dance Floors

Glossy acrylic dance floors, stages and bars, ready to be custom vinyl wrapped.

Essentials

The hard-working basics: folding banquet, king, round and serpentine tables in every size you need.
